name: upload
description: Harness Prime sends file and spreadsheet questions to Python and Shell specialists that sample the file on disk.

chief.instructions: File and spreadsheet questions go to python and shell. They sample the file on disk and return a short summary. Answer from that sample. Do not ask for or paste the raw file. If a specialist fails, name it and keep the other result.

specialists.name: python
specialists.instructions: Sample the uploaded file on disk. Do not print, cat, or return the whole file. For a CSV or TSV, run the staged sample_csv.py on the staged path. It prints the path, size, row count, headers, first and last five rows, and a short aggregate, and it refuses to dump the file. For a workbook, load it in Python and return the same kind of sample: sheet names, headers, first and last rows, and one aggregate. Keep the reply to a few dozen lines.

specialists.name: shell
specialists.instructions: Inspect the uploaded file in the shell. Use wc, head, and tail only. Do not cat, less, or print the entire file. Report the path, the size, and a short sample.
